'''Cuthallox''' was the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Blendri]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] during the Order's early years. Joining her master and several other Jedi, Cuthallox became a Jedi Renunciate and a Legionnaire of [[Lettow]], one of the many followers of [[Xendor]] during the [[First Great Schism]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], Cuthallox lived on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]], the home of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during its early years. Apprenticed to the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Blendri]], Cuthallox and Blendri became enamored with the enigmatic teachings of [[Xendor]],<ref name="JvS" /> who preached that the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] was too restrictive in their teachings and wished to limit understanding of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. When Xendor parted with the Order to found an [[Legionnaire Academy|academy]] on [[Lettow]],<ref name="TEGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> Cuthallox and Blendri departed with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jook-jook H'broozin]] to learn from Xendor.<ref name="JvS" /> Calling themselves the [[Legions of Lettow]], the Jedi Renunciates grew strong in the Force as they studied the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Bogan]] through many different Force-traditions.<ref name="TEGTW" />

When the High Council declared war on the Legions of Lettow, Cuthallox and Blendri took up [[Force-imbued sword/Legends|swords]] to protect their right to study the Force. Meeting the Order in a full-blown conflict that would come to be known as the [[First Great Schism]], the Master-[[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] pair jumped from world to world to fight off the Jedi. During [[Duel on Corulag|duel]] on [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]], Jedi Padawan [[Danzigorro Potts]] killed Master H'broozin and attempted to kill Cuthallox and Blendri, but the pair managed to escape. Padawan Potts would continue to hunt the pair throughout the war until he finally met them on the field of [[Battle of Columus|battle]] at [[Columus/Legends|Columus]]. Engaging Potts, Cuthallox was outmatched and killed.<ref name="JvS" />
